tools.name: check_contract_free
tools.description: Free, no wallet. Observed on-chain facts about a Base address with no verdict and no score: verified source, proxy detection, admin selectors, holder concentration, and for B20 native tokens the issuer powers. Rate limited; a monthly quota applies.

tools.name: flash_audit_terms
tools.description: Returns the x402 v2 PaymentRequired document for the paid Flash Report: amount in USDC base units, network, asset, payTo and the request schema. Free. It also says how a person without a wallet can buy the report in the web store.

tools.name: buy_flash_audit
tools.description: Paid over x402 in USDC on Base. Without a payment in _meta["x402/payment"] it returns the PaymentRequired document (isError), followed by how a person without a wallet can buy the same report in the web store. With a valid PaymentPayload it validates, settles asynchronously and returns an orderKey t

tools.name: collect_flash_audit
tools.description: Status of an x402 order while it settles and generates; once DELIVERED, the report JSON itself. Poll every 10-15 seconds. Free.

tools.name: contract_data_catalog
tools.description: Free, no wallet. Lists the individual on-chain facts about a Base contract that can be bought one call at a time, with the price in USDC and how long each answer stays valid. Read this before paying: the bundle costs less than buying the parts.

tools.name: buy_contract_data
tools.description: Paid over x402 in USDC on Base, from 0.0049 per call. Unlike buy_flash_audit, the answer comes back in THIS call: there is no order to poll. findings.detail: Description of "buy_flash_audit" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "buy_contract_data" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
